tldr: A new mRNA vaccine for melanoma has shown success in late-stage trials, potentially reducing the recurrence and spread of skin cancer.
Hong Kong activists who organized annual Tiananmen Square vigils were found guilty of "incitement to subversion" under the national security law.
A charter plane crash near a remote radar site in western Alaska killed all eight people on board.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite experienced declines, amidst broader market caution. Hedge funds reportedly had their worst underperformance against the S&P 500 in July in over two decades, contributing to volatility and portfolio adjustments. Investor concerns over U.S. debt and stubbornly high Treasury yields may also have played a role.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased slightly, reflecting ongoing bond market jitters and concerns about the U.S.'s $40 trillion debt. JPMorgan's James Sullivan suggested that government bond intervention risks merely delaying problems, indicating underlying pressures in the market.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, rose. This increase suggests heightened investor uncertainty and fear, which can be linked to the general market declines, bond jitters, and debt concerns noted in financial reports.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate saw a slight decrease in the latest weekly Freddie Mac survey. The articles do not provide specific reasons for this particular weekly movement, though mortgage rates generally track the direction of 10-year Treasury yields over recent days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Patreon announced new features and algorithm updates aimed at helping smaller creators gain discovery and build a better network.
Google will introduce a new feature allowing users to customize their Discover feed using an AI chatbot-tuned system, which will learn and remember preferences.

A US company, Reflect Orbital, plans to launch a test satellite later this year that will extend an 18-by-18-meter mirror in orbit, which could unintentionally brighten the night sky for many people, according to a new study.

world.summary: Two Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, who organized annual vigils commemorating China's Tiananmen crackdown, have been found guilty of "incitement to subversion" under the national security law.
In Nigeria, villagers buried bodies after an overloaded boat carrying people, including many children, to farms capsized.

us.summary: A woman was arrested following an FBI sting operation as part of an investigation into an alleged plot to bomb the New York State Capitol building in Albany.
Federal officials are thinning herds of wild horses on federal lands in Colorado, stating that the growing population is depleting natural resources.
A charter aircraft carrying eight people crashed at a remote radar site in western Alaska, resulting in no survivors, according to the U.S. military.

science.summary: A new mRNA vaccine for melanoma, developed by Merck and Moderna, has shown success in late-stage trials, with potential to reduce the recurrence and spread of skin cancer.
A study found that children living in an ultra-low emission zone experienced lung recovery, with their lung capacity catching up to their peers in less polluted areas.
